title: Healers / Tickets-Passes / Room Command Relocation Closure

claims.claim: Native HELP documents BUY HEALING in an appropriate room as healing all wounds for a price; healer services are MajorMUD gameplay rather than inn-rest or transportation behavior.

Decoded room action scripts contain 132 room-owned trigger lines across textblocks 159, 1602-1606, 1608-1611 and 4351 whose exact line shape is monsters -> price -> cast -> adddelay and whose cast spell is healer spell 219-224. Pass 23 executes the recovered presence, price/debit and spell effect while preserving adddelay as unresolved timing.

Decoded price operands are carried-currency copper-value units: Pass 22 independently correlates price 10000 with the Dead Jester native 100-gold wager, while the recovered currency authority defines gold=100 copper units. Pass 23 therefore debits decoded healer prices through the same denomination authority.

Healer price lines reference native message 318 for insufficient funds; the retained WCCMSG2 payload is exactly "You cannot afford that service." Pass 23 returns that native payload when carried currency is below the decoded price.

Decoded healer casts use spells 219 minor healing, 220 major healing, 221 greater healing, 222 cure poison, 223 cure disease and 224 remove curse. Pass 23 reuses existing spell/cure/remove-curse authorities instead of creating service-only formulas.
Classic travel is not a transport service. Existing native type-17 Ticket/Item exit gates require possession of the decoded ticket/pass and deliberately do not consume it until consumption is proven.

The decoded textblock graph contains 45 room-owned trigger lines across 13 action-script textblocks whose entire matched line is only native message/text presentation plus one immediate teleport. Pass 23 resolves the action by source map/room and exact entered phrase, renders retained native payloads, moves immediately to the decoded map/room, saves the session location, and admits room-entry NPC respawns.

Examples directly decoded include room 2/1306 GO/ENTER/CRAWL/CLIMB HOLE -> map 2 room 487 with messages 767/768; room 10/235 READ/LOOK BOOK -> map 15 room 740 with messages 2585/2950; and room 17/1742 LOVE/SAY LOVE -> map 17 room 1743 with messages 2986/2987.
